Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Data scientists annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Data Scientists ($164,740). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $164,740, Austin $127,360, Chicago $107,640. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Data scientists?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Data Scientists (8,370 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Seattle 8,370, Chicago 7,940, Austin 3,730. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Data scientists most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (2.38). Published LQs: Seattle 2.38, Austin 1.71, Chicago 1.04.

What is the hourly median for Data scientists in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $61.23; Chicago $51.75; Seattle $79.20. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
